name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• 15 language choices for voice input (was 6). New: Indonesian, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese, Chinese (Traditional) and Auto-detect; German, Spanish and French got their own entries.
• Each language now uses the engine that measured best on human recordings. Same clips, 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0: Indonesian 95.7% -> 29.1% word errors, Japanese 80.7% -> 22.1% and Korean 75.6% -> 13.8% character errors.
• Long dictations are decoded in parts while you hold the key. On a busy PC, a dictation of one to one and a half minutes in English, Mandarin or Spanish was typed 0.2 to 1.4 s after release instead of 13 to 20 s.
• English no longer loses what you say after 30 seconds: 9 wrong words of 98 in a 56-second recording, where 1.2.0 got 51 wrong.
• Short dictations type sooner on a busy PC: about 1.0 s after release instead of 3.0 to 4.8 s, with the same text.
• My words no longer rewrites everyday words or people's names: 0 wrong replacements on 721 test texts (1.2.0 made 56 on 684), 37,809 names from 63 languages are left alone, and a badly misheard term such as "Bizaira's" still becomes ZIRIS.
• Fillers are removed in 11 languages, spoken corrections work in 7 ("Rapatnya jam tiga, eh salah, jam empat" types "Rapatnya jam empat") and edit commands in 9. Buddy's AI is asked to answer in the language of the question.
• The first-use download shows size, speed and time left, unpacks 38 to 43% faster, and Buddy says how far it is if you try voice input meanwhile. Voice input has its own Settings tab.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
